content: A remedy is defined as a medicine, application, or treatment that alleviates or cures a disease. A cure refers to a method, device, or medication that restores good health. It can also be described as the act of healing or the state of being healed, involving the restoration of health following a disease or the return to soundness after an injury. Medicines are substances specifically designed to promote healing, which are ingested or consumed in some manner. They can also refer to treatments or cures, as well as the scientific study of the causes, diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of diseases or illnesses. Nutraceuticals are defined as nutrients or foods believed to possess curative properties, or foods that are used as drugs. A nutraceutical, also known as a bioceutical, is considered a pharmaceutical alternative that claims to provide physiological benefits. In the United States, nutraceuticals are largely unregulated. They fall under the same category as dietary supplements and food additives, as classified by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) under the authority of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.
